line: They say ‘Stay woke,’ still slept with the rugers The only time you bear arms is in a wife beater, loser
vault_lines: They say 'Stay woke,' still slept with the rugers
meaning:
“Stay woke” is a term originating from African Americans, that refers to the recognition of issues concerning social justice and racial justice while continuing to be aware of these issues throughout the distractions and negativities of social media and other social outlets.

Mensa insists that the “Woke” people still sleep with Ruger’s, (Hand-Gun) to be aware of foes, while bearing arms.

line: Had Virgil overnight these My off whites on fire like white people burnin’ their Nikes Kaepernick called me, told me ‘Just do it’
meaning:
In these lines, Mensa name drops both Virgil Abloh’s  shoes and Colin Kaepernick’s Nike deal.

The term “fire” is slang for, essentially, cool. Mensa uses this slang term to reference the protest made by primarily white people against Colin Kaepernick signing to Nike. Mensa also uses Kaepernick’s Nike deal to reference Nike’s slogan, “Just Do It.”

line: Your favorite rapper’s a domestic abuser, ay Name a single Vic Mensa song *** we all know you won’t live that long I don’t respect ****** posthumously Homicide ain’t new to me, catch up with Akademiks at your eulogy
vault_lines: *** we all know you won't live that long
meaning:
In these lines, Mensa disses three others:

The first of the three is Tekashi 6ix9ine. In an interview with Angie Martinez, 6ix9ine asked several of his friends to name “one Vic Mensa song,” and nobody can. It is also clear that he is referring to the rapper’s Sexual Exploitation of a Child case. This is not out of character for Mensa to diss 6ix9ine, as he has done so before.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X-d8sqhCUKg
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pEQvUmrp9yU

The second, and, arguably, most notable of the three is XXXTENTACION. Headlines were made based on this particular diss, with many taking offense to it, as Mensa was knowingly disrespecting X after his passing, and in front of his mother at that. Mensa responded to the backlash, saying that the only thing he regretted was doing it in front of X’s mom, who he did not know would be there.

https://twitter.com/IamAkademiks/status/1049432088376737792

The third of the three is DJ Akademiks. Mensa seems to poke fun of Akademiks' friendships with both of the aforementioned artists in the last line. Mensa and Akademiks have a long history, with both going back and forth several times.

meaning: XXXTENTACION is using lyrics from his acapella rap MIGHT OFF MYSELF FOR 2017.
